content: Previous work BIBREF1 , BIBREF2 , BIBREF10 has revealed that recognizing explicit vs. implicit discourse relations requires different strategies. Note that in the PDTB dataset, explicit discourse relations were distinguished from implicit ones, depending on whether a discourse connective exists between two discourse units. Therefore, explicit discourse relation detection can be simplified as a discourse connective phrase disambiguation problem BIBREF1 , BIBREF2 . On the contrary, predicting an implicit discourse relation should rely on understanding the overall contents of its two discourse units BIBREF2 , BIBREF10 .
